caption: The drawing shows an oval-shaped, metallic-looking plaque depicted in shades of brown and black, with a subtle texture to suggest a cast-iron or bronze material. At the center of the plaque is a raised relief image of a vintage steam locomotive with prominent features, including two large wheels at the front, one smaller wheel toward the middle, a tall chimney to the left, a cylindrical boiler, and a tall dome-shaped element to the right. Flanking the locomotive, there are two large letters: "U" on the left and "F" on the right. There are small holes at both horizontal edges of the plaque, indicating possible mounting points. At the bottom right of the image, outside the plaque, the name "EMILE CERO" is written in small, clear letters. The background is plain and lightly colored, contrasting with the darker central object.
title: Firemark
